info.name: Booksales API - Complete Test Suite
info.description: Autentikasi JWT. Read all & show Books/Authors/Genres publik; create, update, destroy hanya admin. Transactions: create, update, show hanya customer terautentikasi; read all & destroy hanya admin. Jalankan collection secara berurutan (folder Auth lebih dulu untuk mengisi admin_token & customer_token).

exec: pm.test('Book memiliki genre dan author', function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property('genre'); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('author'); });
pm.test('Total = harga buku x quantity', function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(Number(d.total_amount)).to.eql(Number(d.book.price) * d.quantity); });
pm.test('Relasi customer & book dimuat', function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property('customer'); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('book'); });
pm.test('Relasi book.genre & book.author dimuat', function () { const b = pm.response.json().data.book; pm.expect(b).to.have.property('genre'); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('author'); });

pm.test('Setiap transaksi memuat customer & book', function () { pm.response.json().data.forEach(function (t) { pm.expect(t).to.have.property('customer'); pm.expect(t).to.have.property('book'); }); });
